newsitem.title: FRANCE: Prime appointed City Jet agent.
newsitem.headline: Prime appointed City Jet agent.

text.p: Prime Air Services said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent for Irish airline, City Jet, which operates a daily BAe 146 passenger service between Paris/CDG and Dublin.

"The appointment was made last month with the the launch of the service and we have made an encouraging start, the 146 being able to handle up to two tonnes of freight per flight, weekends excluded, which is well-suited for small volume shipments," a Prime Air official told Reuters.
